init_logger_setup: init a logger with stdout, stderr handlers and optional file logging for distributed jobs
init_logger_with_file: init a logger that writes logs to a file on rank 0 only
create_log_formatter: create a LogFormatter class that formats log messages with rank, level, and elapsed time
set_root_log_level: set the root logger level to a string or integer logging level value
format_log_message: format a log record message with proper indentation for multiline content and exceptions
